verdict.rationale: Proton Pass is a password manager, and user-configurable background automations (for example scheduled rotation or triggered workflows) are a fair thing to ask of this kind of product, but the evidence shows no such feature. The CLI injects secrets into the user's own scripts and CI/CD pipelines, which is a developer building block run by external tooling, not automations the product itself runs. Pass Monitor is a fixed built-in scan, not an automation the user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
